title: Backpressure: high-water mark on staging buffer with 436/400 responses
description: Add configurable high-water mark to ingest staging buffer ([ingest] max_pending_articles default 1000, max_pending_bytes default 256MB). When exceeded: IHAVE/TAKETHIS returns 436 (RFC 4644 Retry later), POST returns 400 server busy. Backpressure releases automatically as drain catches up. Blocked on: stoa-b4d07bb2.
